beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part three. Texture and motion: color sweeping to terracotta and back, a kinetic grid tiling the initials across the nine-sixteen frame in a four-beat ripple, glitch slices each offset independently then snap clean, and a trail echo with five ghost copies.

Your turn. Paste this: tile my initials across the full frame in a four-by-four kinetic grid with a staggered ripple on each copy — and tell me at what point it stops being a logo animation and starts being a pattern. That line is the one you want to know.
Bear Brown initials, in motion. Part three. Liam, in for Bear.
